policies: [FY2025年报 第八节 五、15 固定资产; 2026半年报 第八节 五、15 相同] 固定资产包括房屋及建筑物、机器设备、运输设备、电子设备及其他。除已提足折旧仍继续使用的固定资产外，对所有固定资产计提折旧，采用平均年限法(年限平均法)。年限: 生产用房20-30年, 受腐蚀生产用房5-10年, 非生产用房10-30年, 其他建筑物5-20年 (残值率0-5%); 机器设备5-10年, 运输设备4-10年, 电子设备及其他3-10年 (残值率0-10%)。FY2023/FY2024/2025H1 policy identical (FY2023 names the last class 其他工具).
[FY2025年报 第八节 五、16 在建工程] 在建工程在达到预定可使用状态之日起，根据工程预算、造价或实际成本等按估计价值结转固定资产，次月起开始计提折旧；办理竣工决算后再调整原值差异。

[FY2025年报 第八节 五、17 借款费用] Borrowing costs directly attributable to qualifying assets (construction longer than 1 year) are capitalized. However, 利息资本化累计金额/本期利息资本化金额 are blank for every significant CIP project in FY2023-2026H1.

[FY2025年报 第八节 五、18 使用权资产; 2026半年报 五、18] Cost model. Straight-line depreciation from the month the lease starts. If ownership at lease end is reasonably certain, depreciated over remaining useful life; otherwise over the shorter of lease term and remaining useful life. Short-term and low-value leases are not capitalized.

[FY2025年报 第八节 五、19 无形资产; 2026半年报 相同] Intangible assets include 土地使用权、软件、专利技术 at cost. Land use rights are amortized straight-line over the grant term (30-70年, lower of contractual and legal term). Software 5-10年, patents 5-20年, straight-line over the shortest of expected, contractual and legal life. Lives and methods are reviewed at each year end. Internally developed intangibles are 0.00% of the balance (FY2025).
[FY2025年报 第八节 五、21 长期待摊费用] Costs with a benefit period over one year are amortized straight-line over that period; any unamortized balance with no future benefit is expensed in full.

[FY2025年报 第八节 五、20 长期资产减值] PPE, CIP and finite-life intangibles are tested when impairment indicators exist. Goodwill is tested annually. Recoverable amount is the higher of fair value less costs of disposal and the present value of future cash flows. Impairment losses are not reversed.
[FY2025年报 第八节 五 投资性房地产] Cost model. Depreciation and amortization follow the same methods as PPE and intangible assets.

[Raised funds, FY2025年报 第五节 / 2026半年报 第三节] 2021 private placement: gross 390,000万元 (3,900,000,000元), net 387,981.17万元 (3,879,811,700元), listed 2021-12-17. MLCC expansion (高容量系列多层片式陶瓷电容器扩产项目): 预定可使用状态日期 postponed from 2024-05-10 to 2025-05-10 (per FY2023年报) and then from 2025-05-10 to 2027-05-31 (already shown in the FY2024年报 and repeated in 2025H1/FY2025/2026H1). Implementing entities: 南充三环 and 德阳三环 (Sichuan). 深圳三环研发基地建设项目 was completed by 2024-06-30 and closed on 2024-07-22, with 节余募集资金 1,337.34万元 moved permanently to working capital. On 2022-05-17, 1,316.97万元 of self-funded pre-investment was replaced with raised funds. Unused funds are held in special accounts or cash management.
